subject: DFS ingestion landed 2026-10-13
body: DFS/ownership ingestion landed for domain 2.9. Script intelligence/ingestion/dfs/ingest_dfs.py (stdlib-only, keyless) ran live against DraftKings public lobby (/lobby/getcontests?sport=NFL, 4,909,996 bytes, 6 requests total) plus 4 Google News RSS DFS feeds; robots.txt respected (DK /lineup/ disallowed, so no live per-player salary/ownership - documented as a gap, not substituted). Landed 517 typed records across 10 types: ownership_projection 7, chalk_flag 16, leverage_spot 31, stack_correlation 20 (loadings parsed from existing apps/web/lib/fantasy/dfs-correlation.ts), value_curve_point 40, positional_scarcity 5, punt_play 15, contest_shape 96 (bounded sample of 6,386 parsed contests; full census in CSV), payout_structure_point 60, narrative_mention 227. Artifacts: docs/data-sources/research/2026-10-13/dfs/ (digest json+md, dk-contests-census.csv, dk-lobby-raw-meta.json, 4 raw RSS xml); spec at docs/ops/DFS-INGEST-2026-10-13.md; trainer feed appended added=8 dupes_skipped=0.
